subject: Coupa invite fails — Organization ID missing during activation
messages:
From: Priya Rao <procurement@altauge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation link fails for supplier invite

Hi Jordan,

We received the Coupa supplier invite for Altauge yesterday but when our vendor clicks the activation link it immediately lands on an error page: 'Organization not found — please contact your administrator.' We have two vendors stuck (ACME Fabrication and Meridian Tools).

Steps we tried: cleared cache, different browser, and used a private window. Same result. Screenshot attached.

Can you take a look? We need these suppliers live by Monday so PO processing can start.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Procurement Manager
Altauge Inc.
Attachment: onboarding-error-screenshot.png (image/png)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation link fails for supplier invite

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the report and the screenshot — that message usually indicates the invite token arrived at the Coupa handler without a required query param (org_id) or the relay/state exchange got dropped by an intermediate proxy. Two quick asks to help us triage:

- Can you paste one of the full invite URLs you sent (just the link, we won't attempt to open it)?
- Can you confirm whether the invite was generated from Coupa or via a CSV bulk invite from your side?

In parallel I'll ask Ben to see whether our onboarding proxy logged a dropped relaystate for Altauge yesterday afternoon. If we can confirm the token and org mapping we can either re-issue a corrected invite or do a manual activation on our side.

Workaround: if you can share the supplier email addresses we can bind them to the Altauge org manually and provide a one-time activation link.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(On call: 415-555-0198)

—Priya

Hi Priya —

Thanks, got the URL and the spreadsheet. I manually bound the two supplier emails to Altauge's organization id in our onboarding service and generated one-time activation links that bypass the relay/state exchange. You should see two emails from Redwood on behalf of Altauge going to acme@acme-fab.com and ops@meridian-tools.com in the next 10 minutes.

Action items logged:
- HubSpot deal updated: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/DL-7831 (I added notes and set 'Onboarding: manual activation')
- I uploaded the supplier form to your shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboard-altauge

Root cause (brief): Coupa invite URL lacked a preserved org_id in the redirect after passing through Altauge's SSO proxy — the relaystate param was dropped. Ben flagged this with our ops team; engineering will add defensive parsing for tokens missing org_id and emit a clearer error + retry path.

Please confirm once your vendors have accepted the activation and can receive POs. If anything else pops up I'll keep the ticket open until confirmed.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
